name: coordination/refusal-execution-key-conflict
description: An `execution_key` already committed to a different (stage_ref, consent_receipt). Refused rather than resolved either way: the key names ONE attempt, so reusing it for other arguments is a driver bug, and guessing which of the two the caller meant is how a retry silently becomes a second dispatch.

problem.title: that execution_key already names a different dispatch
